title: Decoding nitrogen uptake efficiency in maize and sorghum: insights from comparative gene regulatory networks
genotypes: B73 (maize); sorghum BTx623 also profiled with the same design (non-Zea)
tissue: leaf (2nd and 3rd fully developed leaves); root (seminal + crown roots pooled)
stage_age: fifth-leaf stage; 3-d germination then 12 d in normal-N solution before N removal
growth_system: hydroponic (Magnavaca nutrient solution); growth chamber 16/8 h, 30/23 °C, 600 µmol m-2 s-1
N_treatments: NN = Magnavaca solution (NO3- concentration NR) -> LN = all nitrate salts removed (Ca(NO3)2 replaced by CaCl2) -> nitrate re-supplied after 24 h LN
timepoints_duration: LN 0, 0.5, 3, 24 h; recovery 0.5 and 24 h after nitrate resupply (24.5 and 48 h)
n_libraries: NR (maize: 2 tissues x 5-6 time points x 3 reps; total not stated)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500; poly(A) Epicentre ScriptSeq libraries (maize); read length/layout NR
other_omics: enhanced yeast one-hybrid (eY1H) GRN (1625 PDIs, 301 TFs, 70 promoters); sorghum RNA-seq
key_finding: Maize eY1H NUE network (1625 PDIs); bZIP18/bZIP30 hubs; 19,236 maize DEGs across N deprivation/recovery
source_of_details: PMC full text; Data Availability from CSHL institutional repository PDF
notes: Data Availability absent from PMC text and taken from repository PDF; BioProject may also contain sorghum reads; GEO series hold processed TPM only; 0-h sample listed in growth methods but RNA-seq methods list 0.5-48 h

title: Genome-Wide Identification of the YABBY Gene Family in Maize and Its Expression Analysis Under Low Phosphorus and High Nitrogen Stress
genotypes: B73; 082; 107 (inbreds; 082 and 107 chosen for differing P-use efficiency, not N)
stage_age: three-leaf stage at transfer + 14 d treatment
N_treatments: control = complete Hoagland (2 mM Ca(NO3)2 + 1.25 mM NH4NO3) vs high N (HN) = 5 mM KNO3 (whether added to or replacing control N not stated)
other_factors: low P (5 µM KH2PO4) as a parallel treatment (not crossed with N)
other_omics: qRT-PCR; YABBY gene-family bioinformatics; subcellular localization
key_finding: 12 ZmYABBY genes defined; several responsive (mostly induced) under high N and low P in seedlings
notes: Data Availability statement not captured (MDPI back matter missing from PMC text); only company FPKM used for a YABBY heatmap; HN is N excess, not deficiency

title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Proteomic Analyses of Low-Nitrogen-Stress Tolerance and Function Analysis of ZmGST42 Gene in Maize
genotypes: XY335 (low-N tolerant hybrid); HN138 (low-N sensitive hybrid)
tissue: leaf (RNA-seq methods: uppermost fully expanded leaf; sampling section: ~10 cm mid-section of ear leaf)
stage_age: grain filling, R3 (21 d after silking)
growth_system: field, Xinji Experimental Station (Hebei Agricultural University), 2018; split-plot, 3 plot replicates, 67,500 plants/ha
N_treatments: N0 (0 kg N/ha) vs N240 (240 kg N/ha), urea (46% N), 50% pre-sowing + 50% at V12
other_factors: genotype (2 hybrids); basal P2O5 90 and K2O 120 kg/ha
other_omics: TMT proteomics (12 samples); physiology; ZmGST42 EMS mutant (B73 background) physiology under hydroponic LN 0.04 vs NN 4 mM (no RNA-seq)
key_finding: Low-N-tolerant XY335 had more low-N-specific leaf DEGs (761) than HN138 (259); ZmGST42 mutant less tolerant
notes: Data Availability not captured (MDPI page blocked by robot check); read-mapping details cited to authors' previous paper, so the RNA-seq data may have been reported earlier (not verified)

title: Nitrate sensing by the maize root apex transition zone: a merged transcriptomic and proteomic survey
tissue: root apex transition-zone-enriched segment (zone 2: 0.8-cm segment behind the apical 3 mm)
stage_age: 4-d-old seedlings (24 h nitrate depletion before treatment)
growth_system: hydroponic nutrient solution (conditions per cited earlier protocol; chamber details NR)
N_treatments: -N (nitrate-starved) vs +N 1 mM NO3- (salt NR) after 24 h nitrate depletion
other_factors: none for RNA-seq (NO inhibitors tungstate and cPTIO used only in qPCR)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq2000; single-read (length NR); Illumina mRNA-Seq Sample Prep kit v2
other_omics: iTRAQ proteomics; qRT-PCR in 4 root zones; NO-inhibitor treatments
key_finding: 1 mM nitrate (2 h) altered 154 transition-zone DEGs; links nitrate to auxin, strigolactone, brassinosteroid and NO signalling
notes: Only 2 biological replicates (26-66 M reads per library); single induction time point; no accession in PMC main text and none found by web search (supplementary files not checked)

title: Nitrogen Deficiency Outperforms Water Stress in Triggering Strigolactone-Dependent Responses in Maize
tissue: whole root system (RNA-seq); third leaf, stem and root for qRT-PCR
stage_age: 28 d after transplanting (4 weeks of growth)
growth_system: vermiculite pots (7 x 7 x 18 cm); controlled environment 16/8 h, 23/20 °C, 280 µmol m-2 s-1
N_treatments: CT = complete Hoagland (3x per week) vs 0N = same solution with 1 mM KNO3 replaced by equimolar KCl
other_factors: water stress (no irrigation after transplanting) as a parallel treatment; nutrient starvation (water only) not sequenced; genotype (zmccd8)
bio_reps: NR for RNA-seq (qRT-PCR: 3 reps of 4 pooled plants)
platform_layout: Illumina (model NR); strand-specific dUTP; paired-end (length NR); HaploX
other_omics: qRT-PCR; leaf chlorophyll/anthocyanin (Dualex); biomass and adventitious-root traits
key_finding: zmccd8 roots lack WT N-deficiency transcriptional response (N transport/assimilation, ethylene, TFs); water-stress response largely SL-independent
notes: Data Availability statement not captured in PMC text and no accession found by web search; NS treatment excluded from RNA-seq; 46.6-57.7 M raw reads per sample

title: Integration of GWAS and Co-Expression Network Analysis Identified Main Genes Responsible for Nitrogen Uptake Traits in Seedling Waxy Corn
genotypes: B73 (RNA-seq); 534 waxy corn inbreds used for GWAS only
stage_age: NR (seedlings after 2 weeks of N starvation)
N_treatments: 2 weeks N starvation then 10 mM KNO3 supply
n_libraries: NR (6 time points x 2 or 3 reps)
other_omics: GWAS (534 waxy inbreds; leaf nitrate content; 2 field environments, no N levels); WGCNA
key_finding: Leaf nitrate-induction time course (WGCNA) plus GWAS of 534 waxy lines identified four N-uptake candidate genes
notes: Data Availability not captured (MDPI back matter missing); replicate number and DEG counts inconsistent (4559 vs 7744); RNA-seq analysis 'based on previous studies', so it may be an earlier dataset; growth system and age not stated

title: Genome-wide association study and transcriptome analysis identify candidate genes associated with low nitrogen-induced root plasticity in Zea mays L.
genotypes: inbred lines with contrasting low-N root responses (high- vs low-response; names NR) from a 387-accession panel (4 subpopulations)
tissue: NR (root traits studied; RNA-seq tissue not stated in abstract)
stage_age: early growth (seedling) stage; exact age NR
N_treatments: normal N vs low N (concentrations and form NR)
other_omics: GWAS (387 accessions, 1.2 M SNPs); WGCNA; haplotype analysis
key_finding: 848 DEGs in high-response vs 431 in low-response lines; four core root-plasticity candidate genes
source_of_details: abstract only (PMC full text returned empty) + web search
notes: All design details come from the abstract; full text needed for genotypes, tissue, N levels and accession; new RNA-seq generation implied by the abstract but not confirmed
